newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk opposition to submit govt censure by Friday.
newsitem.headline: Turk opposition to submit govt censure by Friday.

text.p: Turkish conservative leader Mesut Yilmaz said on Thursday opposition MPs were aiming to submit a censure motion by the weekend to topple the Islamist- conservative coalition, according to the Anatolian news agency.
"We are planning to submit the censure motion by tomorrow evening," the state-run agency quoted Yilmaz as saying. "Our aim is to ensure the censure motion is discussed in parliament next week."
Opposition and dissident government MPs have been negotiating for some time to try to bring down the government, led by Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan.
But their efforts suffered a possible setback because of a decision by the junior coalition partner to discipline leading rebel government MP Yalim Erez over his role in the anti-government move.

"The party executive only has the authority to form a government or withdraw from it," Huseyin Uyanik, a senior MP for the True Path Party (DYP), told reporters. "We have been reviewing Mugla MP Yalim Erez's negotiations," he said. "The discipline mechanism has been set in motion."
Erez has asked for an appointment with DYP leader Tansu Ciller to discuss withdrawing from the government, but she has not yet accepted his request.
